messages:
Sam: OK team — finalizing Mariner POC throughput sweep. Plan below. Need: eng-runtime signoff on ramp/queueing, security signoff on TLS/KMS scope, and a quick cost delta estimate for burst pricing. Can we run this Wed 09:00 PT?

Vikram: Wed 09:00 PT works for us. Outline looks good. Quick questions: how long do we hold each concurrency step? I suggest 5m steady state + 2m cooldown so KV cache stabilizes.

Sam: yep 5m steady is fine. Goal is 100/300/600/1200 concurrent requests (thin client inference calls, avg payload ~600 tokens). We'll measure p50/p95/p99 latency and token/sec.

Maria: For pricing, if they sustain 600 concurrent for 5m we should estimate token burn at ~18M tokens/hour equivalency. I'll need a back-of-envelope before the run to flag with finance.

Julian: Can you paste the exact request profile? I want to mirror in our simulator.

Vikram: Request profile below. Use vegeta for sweep. Command:
```
echo "POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate" > targets.txt
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=0 -connections=CONC -duration=5m | vegeta report
```
Replace CONC with 100,300,600,1200. Payload header: `Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>` and `Content-Type: application/json`.

Vikram: Example JSON body snippet:
```
{"model":"openlm-mariner-7b","prompt":"<user prompt>","max_tokens":256}
```
Expect warmup cold-starts first step; plan to discard first 30s of each step for steady-state metrics.

Karen: Security checklist: are we sending any PII in prompts? We need sample payloads and retention settings. Also confirm TLS mutual required? Mariner prospect requested mTLS + customer KMS for keys.

Sam: No PII in synthetic prompts; we'll provide sanitized samples. For KMS they asked about envelope encryption — they want to see KMS integration on Dedicated path. For the hosted POC we can show transit TLS + token-based auth; note the customer flagged HSM latency concerns.

Karen: Got it. For hosted demo, confirm logs are not persisted beyond session and that we can turn off retention. Also need SOC / ISO cert pointers for the prospect pack.

Maria: Finance note — estimate for brief burst (600 qps equivalent) with reserved vs on-demand: can someone give delta? Casual guess: reserved 30% cheaper, but need exact numbers for 1-day POC.

Vikram: Ballpark numbers: on-demand GPU time + token cost ~ $X/hr for that model; reserved capacity amortized to $Y/hr. I'll calculate and send in thread after I run quick sim.

ops-bot: [08:58] Scheduled: mariner-poc-sweep -> Wed 09:00 PT. Notification will be sent 10m prior.

Sam: Perfect. One more: please add a canary step at 50% of target between 300 and 600 to check tail behavior (so 450). Keeps rollbacks cheaper.

Vikram: Added 450 step. Final ramp: 100 -> 300 -> 450 -> 600 -> 1200. I'll script cooldown and discard windows.

Julian: I'll mirror load from client side and record connection churn metrics (TCP resets, keepalive). Anything special about headers? We will send a `x-client-id: mariner-poc` header.

Karen: Please also capture JA3 fingerprinting and consent for any endpoint scanning. I'll review the scheduled test window against our firewall rule updates.

Vikram: Post-run plan: I'll paste vegeta report + small csv of latencies. Quick summary in thread: p50, p95, p99 tokens/sec and errors. If error rate >0.5% we halt and debug.

Maria: FYI I'll prep a one-slide cost-impact summary for customer call after results. Thanks.

Sam: Thanks everyone. Action items: Vikram compute cost delta + run script; Karen security checklist + retention confirmation; Julian client-side metrics; Maria cost slide. Ping me if any blocker.

Vikram: Will post pre-run sim numbers in ~30m and attach a quick cost calc.

Karen: I'll confirm retention toggle and mTLS caveats by EOB today.

ops-bot: [09:00] mariner-poc-sweep -> run started

Vikram: Early numbers from step 100 steady: p50 38ms, p95 84ms, p99 210ms, tokens/sec ~4500, errors 0.02%.

Julian: Client-side saw 3 keepalive resets during 100->300 ramp, nothing fatal.

Vikram: Step 300 steady: p50 56ms, p95 150ms, p99 420ms, tokens/sec ~13k, errors 0.1%.

Vikram: Step 450 steady: p50 82ms, p95 220ms, p99 610ms, tokens/sec ~19k, errors 0.3%.

Vikram: Step 600 steady: p50 120ms, p95 380ms, p99 1.2s, tokens/sec ~25k, errors 0.7% -> above threshold, we throttled queueing to avoid cascading failures.

Sam: Noted. Can you capture logs for the spike? Likely queuing / kv cache eviction.

Vikram: Captured. I'm toggling to 2x batching to see if p99 improves; re-running short 5m test at 600 with batching=2.

Maria: Cost quick note after initial sim: 5m at sustained 600 roughly equates to $Z of on-demand burden — I'll refine once Vikram posts final numbers.

Vikram: Re-run 600 w/ batching=2: p50 95ms, p95 260ms, p99 700ms, tokens/sec ~23k, errors 0.2% — better.

Karen: Security: retention toggle confirmed — logs can be disabled for scoped run. mTLS for hosted demo not available; we noted prospect wants dedicated for KMS/HSM and mTLS. I'll add that as a blocker for hosted acceptance.

Sam: Good catch. We'll include dedicated path in procurement convo. Maria, flag that for pricing.

Maria: Flagged. I'll include dedicated uplift estimate in the slide.

Vikram: Post-run artifacts: vegeta reports (summary pasted), CSV attached to internal wiki. Summary: acceptable up to 450; 600 requires batching changes or reserved capacity tuning; 1200 causes sustained errors >1.5% and high p99s.

Sam: Great. I'll schedule follow-up call with the prospect with these findings and recommended next steps (dedicated trial or batching config). Thanks team :thumbsup: 

Julian: Thanks — will send client-side metrics to wiki.

ops-bot: [09:23] mariner-poc-sweep -> completed

Karen: I'll open a Sec ticket for Dedicated KMS/HSM demo and timeline.

Vikram: Cost delta posted: on-demand ~ $X/day, reserved capacity uplift ~ -30% but requires 1-month minimum on our side; details in the thread link.

Maria: Slide done. Sending to Sam for review.

Sam: Received. Closing loop after customer call. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
